exposure: Before (2006-2011) and after (2013-2018) revision of the South Australian 'Asthma in Pregnancy' perinatal guidelines
outcome: Antenatal corticosteroid treatment for threatened preterm birth
cohort: Pregnant women at the Women's and Children's Hospital in Adelaide, Australia (prevalence of asthma: 7.5%)
finding: While maternal asthma was associated with increased risks of several adverse perinatal outcomes, the revised guidelines in 2012 led to a reduction in asthma-associated risks of Cesarean section, antenatal corticosteroids, and small for gestational age.
